# 9XM Morning Hits

> Free nostalgia web radio streaming classic Bollywood morning hits from the 2000s and 2010s, inspired by 9XM TV morning slots.

## Site
- URL: https://9xmhits.workers.dev/
- Type: Single-page web radio / music player
- Language: English (India), Hindi film music

## What it is
9XM Morning Hits lets listeners stream a curated playlist of ~50 Bollywood songs that defined morning TV nostalgia — Dil Chahta Hai, Kal Ho Naa Ho, Jab We Met, Yeh Jawaani Hai Deewani, Cocktail, Queen, and more. Best experienced between 6–10 AM. Includes Bade & Chote mascot jokes and optional custom YouTube Music playlists.

## Key entities
- Brand inspiration: 9XM (Indian music channel)
- Mascots: Bade and Chote (Bakwaas Bandh Kar)
- Creator: Hrithik Dutta (https://www.hrithikdutta.me/)

## Sample tracks
- Kal Ho Naa Ho (2003)
- Mauja Hi Mauja — Jab We Met (2007)
- Desi Girl — Dostana (2008)
- Badtameez Dil — Yeh Jawaani Hai Deewani (2013)
- London Thumakda — Queen (2014)
